lines.text: Hickory dickory dock, the mouse ran up the clock!
The clock struck one, the mouse ran down, hickory dickory dock!
Tick-tock, tick-tock! How does a clock measure every single second so accurately?
In big grandfather clocks, a swinging pendulum rocks steadily back and forth!
Gravity ensures each swing takes the exact same fraction of a second!
An escapement gear catches and releases, making the famous tick-tock sound!
In modern digital watches, a tiny quartz crystal vibrates thirty-two thousand times a second!
A microchip counts the vibrations and moves the hands forward right on time!
